verdict.rationale: Graphite supports org-wide GitHub App installation and enabling AI review across 'selected repositories' with per-repo custom rules and comment exclusions, and org-wide AI-disable requires emailing support — but there is no documented centralized dashboard for setting org-level review defaults and managing per-repo exceptions at scale across hundreds of repos. missing for 10: evidence of a bulk/org-level policy management UI, audit of exceptions across many repos, and any customer testimonial about managing hundreds of repos centrally.
